tasks.title: ThemeProvider context (mode/resolved state, localStorage, matchMedia)
acceptance_criteria: Exports ThemeProvider component and useTheme() hook returning { mode, resolved, setMode, cycle }.
mode defaults to 'auto' when localStorage has no 'theme' key or an unknown value.
setMode persists the mode string to localStorage['theme'] and updates state.
resolved is 'dark'/'light' derived from mode; when mode is 'auto' it reads matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').
An effect writes resolved to document.documentElement.dataset.theme whenever resolved changes.
In 'auto' mode a matchMedia change event live-updates resolved.
localStorage and matchMedia access are guarded (try/catch / existence check) and never throw.
tests: useTheme defaults to mode 'auto' when localStorage is empty
an unknown localStorage['theme'] value falls back to 'auto'
setMode('dark') sets document.documentElement.dataset.theme to 'dark' and persists 'dark' to localStorage
cycle() advances light -> dark -> auto -> light
in 'auto' mode resolved follows the matchMedia matches value
provider does not throw when matchMedia is undefined

tasks.title: No-flash inline script in index.html head
acceptance_criteria: A synchronous inline <script> in <head> sets document.documentElement.dataset.theme before first paint.
It reads localStorage['theme']; for 'auto' or missing it resolves via matchMedia; sets 'dark' or 'light'.
The script is wrapped in try/catch so a storage error cannot break page load.
tests: index.html contains an inline head script that references localStorage 'theme' and sets documentElement.dataset.theme (asserted by reading the file / smoke test)

tasks.title: Wrap all routes in ThemeProvider
acceptance_criteria: main.jsx wraps <BrowserRouter>/<Routes> tree in <ThemeProvider> so every route (public, login, admin, 404) shares the context.
No visual or routing behavior changes; existing route structure is preserved.
tests: rendering the app tree does not throw and useTheme is available to a descendant of the router
